title: Logistics Career Compass
description:
Logistics Career Compass is Tirwin Talent’s flagship training initiative designed to guide fresh talent into the vast world of logistics, freight forwarding, and global trade. Built by industry veterans, this program combines technical mastery, real-world simulations, and career mentorship to empower learners to become job-ready professionals.

“Navigate. Learn. Deliver.” – Logistics Career Compass
objective: To equip newcomers with practical skills, industry knowledge, and job readiness for careers in logistics, freight forwarding, and export-import operations.
targetAudience: Graduates and diploma holders seeking careers in supply chain, cargo, and EXIM operations
Career switchers entering the logistics domain for the first time
Colleges and institutes looking to offer industry-integrated curriculum
Rural talent ready for skill-based placement opportunities

features.title: Delivery
features.description: Online for 6 - 8 weeks (flexible for weekend or evening batches)

features.title: Industry Mentorship
features.description: Pre-recorded / Virtual live interactions with logistics leaders

features.title: Career Prep
features.description: Resume building, mock interviews, placement support

features.title: Certification
features.description: Recognized credential co-branded by Tirwin Talent

outcomes: Confidently handle real-world logistics and EXIM operations
Build a strong foundation for roles at NVOCCs, freight forwarders, and customs firms
Be interview-ready with mentorship and career support from industry experts

blocks.title: Block 1: Foundations of Logistics & Trade
blocks.subtitle: Laying the groundwork for career clarity and operational understanding
modules: Port of Entry – Introduction to Logistics & EXIM Careers
Supply Chain Foundations – Key concepts in transportation, warehousing, and inventory
EXIM Ecosystem – Overview of global trade and import-export operations
Documentation Deep Dive – Bills, invoices, packing lists, LC, and SOPs

blocks.title: Block 2: Trade Compliance & Freight Operations
blocks.subtitle: Giving learners the toolkit for precision, compliance, and freight handling
modules: Incoterms & Shipping Terms – Understanding trade definitions and responsibilities
Customs Compliance – Customs basics, DGFT processes, GST rules, EOU/STPI protocols
NVOCC & Freight Forwarding Operations – Booking, container handling, consolidation
Tech Tools – Knowledge of digitized logistics platforms, Intro to AI in Logistics

blocks.title: Block 3: Applied Skills & Simulation
blocks.subtitle: Translating knowledge into real-world cargo handling and logistics tech use
modules: Software Tools: WMS/TMS/ERP – Functionality of these applications
Cargo Documentation Simulations – Role-play, mock bookings, SOP creation
Dangerous Goods, Regulatory Risk & Audit – DG goods handling, Trade audits, risk flags, mitigation strategies
Rural & Remote Logistics Planning – Designing accessible supply chain models

blocks.title: Block 4: Career Empowerment & Placement Readiness
blocks.subtitle: Equipping learners with the mindset, soft skills, and mentor guidance to succeed
modules: Soft Skills for Logistics Professionals – Communication, email etiquette, teamwork
Negotiation & Conflict Resolution – Tactics in customs, vendor, and client contexts
Career Toolkit – Resume building, interview prep, LinkedIn visibility
Industry Mentorship & Placement Readiness – Career guidance, certification, job access

pricingOptions.description: Full access to 16 modules, certification, mentor guidance

title: Mastering Conflict & Negotiation
description:
An Executive 6-Hour B2B Masterclass Tailored for Emerging Leaders in Logistics & Supply Chain Operations.

Turn Operational Friction into Business Advantage. Standard leadership workshops focus on abstract corporate communication and fail in logistics because they ignore high-pressure operational friction—such as warehouse SLA breaches, vessel demurrage disputes, and carrier freight rate pinches. This program transforms conflict into operational efficiency, equipping mid-level managers with domain-tailored negotiation tactics to directly reduce SLA delays, protect vendor margins, and avoid multi-party disputes.
objective: To equip emerging leaders in logistics and supply chain operations with practical negotiation tools, conflict resolution frameworks, and real-world supply chain simulations to resolve operational friction, assert commercial firmness, and build resilient business partnerships.
targetAudience: Emerging leaders, operational leads, and mid-level managers in logistics & supply chain operations
Warehouse managers, transport coordinators, and port operations leads handling daily friction
Freight forwarding, NVOCC, and shipper teams negotiating ocean & air freight rates, demurrage, and terms
Supply chain account managers and commercial procurement specialists managing multi-party contracts

features.title: Practical Tools
features.description: Grounded in supply chain reality with frameworks to handle daily operational friction.

features.title: Real-World Scenarios
features.description: Interactive role-plays and simulations analyzing real cases involving NVOCCs, port authorities, freight forwarders, and last-mile delivery partners.

features.title: Logistics Focused
features.description: Flexible online cohort delivery (Zoom / MS Teams) designed around your team's operational shifts with zero operational loss.

features.title: Impact Driven
features.description: Delivers tangible tools including a custom Logistics Dispute Playbook, Individual Action Plan, and HR Executive Impact Report.

outcomes: Resolve operational disputes faster and build stronger, long-term vendor and client partnerships
Negotiate freight rates, demurrage, and contract terms with confidence while creating win-win commercial outcomes
Gain domain-tailored negotiation tactics and conflict resolution frameworks you can apply from Day 1
Exit with tangible workplace deliverables: custom Logistics Dispute Playbook, individual action plan, and HR impact report

blocks.title: Stage 1: Pre-Workshop Diagnostic
blocks.subtitle: Needs survey & dispute case inputs to tailor the learning around your operational reality
modules: Custom online survey sent to participants and HR to capture your company's actual operational pain points
Collection of anonymized workplace dispute examples to ground all simulations in actual business context

blocks.title: Stage 2: 6-Hour Experiential Live Masterclass (4 Core Modules)
blocks.subtitle: Interactive cohort delivery with role-plays, simulations, and expert facilitation
modules: Module 01: Operational & Cross-Functional Conflict – Handling warehouse, transport & port-related disputes; escalation models and emotional intelligence in high-stress ops
Module 02: Commercial & Vendor Negotiation – Applying win-win strategies, BATNA, and freight rate negotiation simulations between NVOCC and shippers
Module 03: Multi-Party Disputes & Contracts – Managing stakeholders, mediation, arbitration, and cross-border friction in 3-way supply chain contracts
Module 04: Crisis Leadership & Collaboration – Building partner trust, collaborative leadership, and managing global supply chain crisis negotiations

blocks.title: Stage 3: Post-Workshop ROI & Impact
blocks.subtitle: Sustained application, playbooks, and organizational impact evaluation
modules: Logistics Dispute Playbook: Quick reference guide for daily vendor, client, and team conflicts
Individual Action Plans: Customized application strategies for ongoing workplace disputes
HR Executive Report & 30-Day Feedback Loop: Post-training evaluation and manager feedback loop
